Image Generation

BoobaStudio's Image Generation feature creates AI-generated artwork for your actors, items, scenes, and journals. Choose from a wide range of models to generate token portraits, item icons, scene backgrounds, and more.

Overview

Image generation uses multiple AI providers (Replicate, OpenAI, Stability AI, Google) to create images from text prompts. BoobaStudio automatically adapts the prompt style based on your game system and the type of content you're generating.

How It Works

  • Select a Document — open an actor, item, or journal
  • Open the Generator — use the BoobaStudio menu or context menu
  • Choose a Model — pick from available image models
  • Enter a Prompt or let BoobaStudio auto-generate one from the document's description
  • Generate — the AI creates an image
  • Apply — set the result as the document's portrait/token/image

Accessing Image Generation

From Actor or Item Sheets

  • Open an actor or item sheet
  • Click the BoobaStudio icon on the sheet header
  • Select Generate Image from the menu

From the Sidebar Context Menu

  • Right-click on any actor, item, or journal in the sidebar
  • Select the BoobaStudio AI option from the context menu

From the BoobaStudio menu

  • Open the BoobaStudio radial menu
  • Select the image generation option
  • Choose to generate for an existing document or create a new one

Available Models

BoobaStudio offers many image generation models, each with different strengths:

  • Flux 2 Klein — Ultra-fast generation, good for rapid iteration
  • Flux 2 Dev — High quality, good balance of speed and detail
  • Flux 2 Pro — Premium quality with advanced controls
  • Flux 2 Max — Maximum quality, best for hero images
  • GPT Image — OpenAI's image model with strong prompt understanding
  • Imagen 4 — Google's latest image generator
  • Ideogram V3 — Excellent text rendering in images
  • Recraft V3 — Strong at vector-style and icon generation
  • Stability SD3.5 — Versatile with image-to-image support
  • Bria FIBO — Fast generation with commercial-friendly licensing

Image-to-Image

Many models support image-to-image generation, which uses an existing image as a starting point:

  • Enable the Image-to-Image checkbox in the model options
  • The current document image is used as the reference
  • Adjust the strength slider to control how much the AI changes the original
  • Lower strength = closer to original, higher strength = more creative freedom

Model Options

Each model has specific options you can adjust:

  • Aspect Ratio — Choose the output image shape (1:1, 16:9, etc.)
  • Megapixels — Resolution of the output image
  • Safety Checker — Toggle content safety filtering (NSFW setting required)
  • Guidance/CFG — How closely the AI follows your prompt
  • Seed — Set a specific seed for reproducible results

Tips

  • Let BoobaStudio write the prompt — the auto-generated prompts are tailored to your game system
  • Try different models — each has a unique artistic style
  • Use image-to-image for consistent character appearances across multiple images
  • Cheaper models like Flux 2 Klein are great for experimenting before using premium models
  • Check your mana balance — each generation costs credits based on the model

Requirements

  • BoobaStudio module installed and configured
  • A configured provider (Module Settings → BoobaStudio)
  • Credit with your configured provider
